AA.name: Artificial Analysis
AA.what: An independent lab that runs the same set of tests on every model and combines them into one Intelligence Index. It also measures how fast each model writes (output tokens per second), how long a task takes, and what it costs to run each test task.
AA.when: Leaderboard viewed November 18, 2026; index scores as captured November 6, 2026
AA.caveat: Scores depend on the effort setting tested. The same model can score 52 at “high” and 59 at “max”, and cost several times more at the higher setting.

ARENA.name: LMArena (text arena)
ARENA.what: People ask two anonymous models the same question and vote for the answer they prefer. Thousands of votes become an Elo-style rating.
ARENA.caveat: It measures which answer people prefer, not whether it's correct. It's the only broad measure of writing quality available, so the Writing ratings are the softest in this catalogue.

TB.name: Terminal-Bench
TB.what: Gives a model real tasks in a computer terminal (setting up software, fixing broken builds, data work) and checks whether the job actually got done.
TB.when: Scores as captured November 6, 2026; Claude Fable 5.2 added November 16
TB.caveat: Kimi K3.1 Pro's score was run by its maker, not checked independently.

APEX.name: Mercor APEX-SWE and APEX-Agents
APEX.what: Tasks written and graded by working professionals. APEX-SWE covers software engineering; APEX-Agents covers multi-step professional work such as finance and consulting tasks.
APEX.caveat: Not every model has been run on both boards, so some ratings lean on one of them.

GDP.name: GDPval-AA
GDP.what: Artificial Analysis's version of OpenAI's GDPval test: realistic work products (reports, spreadsheets, plans) across many occupations, rated against each other.
GDP.caveat: Ratings are relative to the other models tested, so the gaps between them matter more than the raw numbers.

BLM.name: BenchLM monthly rankings
BLM.what: Combines results from more than 100 public benchmarks into boards for overall, coding, reasoning, agentic, knowledge and multimodal ability. Each row is labelled “Supported” (enough independent evidence) or “Estimated” (wider uncertainty).
BLM.used: Coding, Reasoning, Long tasks, Images & media; also a cross-check on everything else
BLM.caveat: Its multimodal board is preliminary because few models have been tested, and several top positions (including Claude Fable 5.2's) are marked Estimated.

PRICE.name: IntuitionLabs API pricing comparison
PRICE.what: A table of official API prices from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and DeepSeek, including cached-input rates and long-prompt surcharges.
PRICE.used: Value, prices shown on each listing
PRICE.caveat: Doesn't cover Gemini 4, Claude Fable 5.2 or Kimi; those prices come from GEO Toolbox.

GEO.name: GEO Toolbox, “Best AI model in November 2026”
GEO.what: A dated roundup that gathers each model's price, context window, which subscription plans include it, and its scores across several leaderboards, all captured on the same day.
GEO.used: Prices, context windows, where to use each model, and most of the leaderboard figures above
GEO.caveat: A secondary source: it reports other leaderboards rather than running its own tests. We checked several of its figures against the original leaderboards and they matched.
